lines.text: Jesus says nothing hidden will stay unknown, and what He tells them in the dark they must speak in daylight.
Jesus says not to fear those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul.
Two sparrows are sold for a talent, yet not one falls apart from the Father's will, and the disciples are worth more.
Jesus says He came to bring a sword, and whoever does not take up his staff and follow Him is not worthy.
Whoever gives a cup of cold water to a disciple will never lose his reward, and Jesus then teaches in their cities.
